lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A cluster of approximately 15-20 discrete, high-luminance circular spots is visible in the region posterior to the gill slits and superior to the pectoral fin. Spatial distribution in the mid-flank region is partially confounded by high-intensity caustic light overlays.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the lateral flank, characterized by a sharp light-to-shadow gradient occurring at the ridge apex, running parallel from the post-cranial region toward the second dorsal fin.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a remora (family Echeneidae) attached to the ventral-lateral region posterior to the left pectoral fin. Intense caustic light patterns (dappled sunlight) are overlaid across the entire visible dorsal and lateral surfaces, creating transient high-luminance artifacts.
